mitools.notes: TypeScript shared library that omni-notify consumed before its Rust port; its upkeep skill was adapted from this repo's.

stillair.notes: Custom ceiling fan project (docs + Rust ESP32 firmware). Bootstrapped its sync skill from here; shares only the sync skill itself.

resources.notes: Shared shape only (sync remote -> survey -> research majors -> apply -> verify -> ship). Steps are environment-specific: this repo is a Rust workspace with exact crate pins, a wasm frontend built by trunk, a Dockerfile with verified downloads, and LLM model IDs; mitools is a published TypeScript library whose CI publishes to npm on a version bump. Port procedure improvements, never the project-specific steps.
